costs.improvementsNote: Level 1 to 5 of each track costs that many of its commodity: 1, then 2, up to 5.

ability.trade: Level 3: trade commodities 2 for 1 with the bank on your turn.
ability.politics: Level 3 (Fortress): strong knights can be promoted to mighty.
ability.science: Level 3 (Aqueduct): a roll that gives you nothing pays a resource of your choice.

improve.title: City improvements
improve.intro: Buy levels with commodities. A metropolis goes on one of your cities at level 4.

buildHint.sideways: Upgrade it before any other settlement
buildHint.activate: A knight must be active to act
buildHint.moveKnight: Along your roads, once per turn
buildHint.displaceKnight: Push a weaker rival knight aside

instruction.confirm: Confirm on the board, or choose another marked spot.
instruction.knight: Choose a marked site for the new knight, then confirm it.
instruction.wall: Choose a city for the wall, then confirm it.
instruction.activate: Choose an inactive knight to activate, then confirm it.
instruction.promote: Choose a knight to promote, then confirm it.
instruction.moveKnight: Choose the knight that will move.
instruction.moveKnightTarget: Choose a marked site to move to, then confirm it.
instruction.displaceKnight: Choose the knight that will push a weaker rival knight aside.
instruction.displaceKnightTarget: Choose the rival knight to displace, then confirm it.
instruction.chase: Choose the knight beside the robber. It becomes inactive.
instruction.sideways: Choose the fallen city to upgrade, then confirm it.
instruction.relocate: Your knight was displaced. Choose a site for it, then confirm it.
instruction.pillage: The barbarians won. Choose which of your cities is lost.
instruction.metropolis: You reached level 4 first. Choose the city that gets the metropolis.
instruction.deserterRemove: A Deserter was played against you. Choose the knight you give up.
instruction.deserterPlace: Place your new knight on a marked site, then confirm it.
instruction.cardWall: Engineer: choose a city for the free wall.
instruction.cardCity: Medicine: choose the settlement to upgrade.
instruction.cardIntrigue: Intrigue: choose a rival knight beside your roads to drive off.
instruction.cardMerchant: Merchant: choose a hex beside one of your buildings.
instruction.cardBishop: Bishop: choose the hex for the robber.
instruction.cardInventor: Inventor: choose the first number token to swap.
instruction.cardInventorTarget: Choose the token to swap it with, then confirm it.
instruction.cardDiplomat: Diplomat: choose an open road to remove.
instruction.cardDiplomatTarget: Choose an edge for your free road, or remove without building.
instruction.cardSmith: Smith: choose a knight to promote for free.
instruction.cardSmithTarget: Choose a second knight to promote, or promote just the first.

confirmTitle.chase: Chase the robber with this knight?

alchemist.instruction: Choose both production dice. Only the event die is rolled.

aqueduct.title: Aqueduct
aqueduct.instruction: The roll gave you nothing. Take one resource of your choice.

barbarians.title: Barbarians
barbarians.holds: The knights would hold the line.
barbarians.falls: The barbarians would win, and the weakest defender loses a city.

reason.victory: A victory point card counts as soon as it is drawn; there is nothing to play.
reason.notYourTurn: Not your turn. Progress cards are played on your own turn.
reason.busy: Wait for the last move to finish.
reason.onlyBeforeRoll: Only before rolling: play it at the start of your next turn.
reason.afterRoll: Play after rolling: roll the dice first.
reason.finishStep: Finish the current step of your turn first.
reason.robberLocked: Needs the robber to be active: it is locked until the barbarians first attack.

crane.choose: Choose the improvement to buy with the Crane

deck.title: Draw a progress card
deck.instruction: You tied for the strongest defense. Choose the deck to draw from.

discardProgress.title: Too many progress cards
discardProgress.instruction: You may hold four progress cards. Choose {{count}} to discard.

harbor.replyInstruction: {{player}} offers you a card face down. Give back a commodity.
harbor.replyAnonymous: A card is offered face down. Give back a commodity.
harbor.returnOffer: Return the offer (you hold no commodity)
harbor.offerInstruction: Offer a resource face down to each rival. They must give back a commodity.
harbor.nobody: No rival can take an offer now.

spy.title: Spy: {{player}}'s progress cards
spy.instruction: Take one of these cards, or none.

saboteur.title: Sabotage
saboteur.instruction: A Saboteur strikes. Discard {{count}} cards to the bank.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.text: Before you roll, choose both production dice. Only the event die is rolled.

crane.name: Crane
crane.text: Buy a city improvement for one commodity less. Level 1 is free.

engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.text: Build a city wall for free.

inventor.name: Inventor
inventor.text: Swap two number tokens. Not the 2, 6, 8 or 12.

irrigation.name: Irrigation
irrigation.text: Take 2 grain for every fields hex beside your buildings.

medicine.name: Medicine
medicine.text: Upgrade a settlement to a city for 1 grain and 2 ore.

mining.name: Mining
mining.text: Take 2 ore for every mountains hex beside your buildings.

printer.name: Printer
printer.text: One victory point, kept face up.

smith.name: Smith
smith.text: Promote up to two of your knights one level, for free.

commercialHarbor.name: Commercial Harbor
commercialHarbor.text: Offer each rival a resource. Each answers with a commodity.

masterMerchant.name: Master Merchant
masterMerchant.text: Look at the hand of a rival who leads you, and take 2 cards.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.text: Place the merchant by your building: 2 for 1 trades there, and 1 VP while it is yours.

merchantFleet.name: Merchant Fleet
merchantFleet.text: This turn, trade one kind of card 2 for 1 with the bank.

resourceMonopoly.name: Resource Monopoly
resourceMonopoly.text: Name a resource. Every rival gives you up to 2.

tradeMonopoly.name: Trade Monopoly
tradeMonopoly.text: Name a commodity. Every rival gives you 1.

bishop.name: Bishop
bishop.text: Move the robber and take a card from every rival beside it.

constitution.name: Constitution
constitution.text: One victory point, kept face up.

deserter.name: Deserter
deserter.text: A rival gives up a knight. You place a knight of your own for free.

diplomat.name: Diplomat
diplomat.text: Remove an open road. If it was yours, you may build a road for free.

intrigue.name: Intrigue
intrigue.text: Drive a rival knight off a site your roads reach, without a knight.

saboteur.name: Saboteur
saboteur.text: Every rival with as many points as you, or more, discards half its hand.

spy.name: Spy
spy.text: Look at a rival's progress cards and take one.

warlord.name: Warlord
warlord.text: Activate all your knights for free.

wedding.name: Wedding
wedding.text: Every rival with more points than you gives you 2 cards.

readiness.activatedThisTurn: Activated this turn: ready next turn

idle.notYours: Only its owner can use this knight.
idle.notYourTurn: Not your turn. Knights act in your own action phase.
idle.afterRoll: Roll the dice first: knights act after the roll.
idle.finishStep: Finish the current step of your turn first.
idle.inactive: An inactive knight cannot move or act. Activate it (1 grain); it can act from your next turn. A knight that acted this turn is inactive too.
idle.activatedThisTurn: It was activated this turn, so it can move or act from your next turn.
idle.noTarget: No empty spot along your roads to move to, no weaker knight to displace, and no robber beside it.

attack.title: Barbarians attack!
attack.defender: {{player}} led the defense: +1 VP (Defender of Catan).
attack.defenderYou: You led the defense: +1 VP (Defender of Catan).
attack.tied: {{players}} tied for the lead: each draws a progress card.
attack.tiedYou: You tied for the lead: pick a deck to draw from.
attack.noLeader: No knights were active, so nobody earns a Defender card.
attack.lostYou: Your city by {{place}} fell and is a settlement now. Your knights gave {{mine}}, the fewest ({{defense}} vs {{strength}} in all).
attack.onlyCity: It was your only city, so there was nothing to choose.
attack.choosing: {{player}} is choosing which city to lose.
attack.choosingYou: Your knights gave {{mine}}, the fewest: choose which city you lose.
attack.nothingToLose: No player had a city the barbarians could take.
attack.lowest_one: The weakest defenders had {{count}} active knight level.
attack.lowest_other: The weakest defenders had {{count}} active knight levels.
